title: Failed logins for one username do not lock a different username out from the same client address

criteria.given: a client address that has just failed to log in repeatedly as an unknown user
criteria.then: that user is locked out (429) for the window

criteria.given: the same client address, a different and valid user presenting the correct password
criteria.then: the login is not blocked: the lockout is keyed on (client IP, username), not the IP alone

steps.name: repeated bad Basic credentials for an unknown user trip the lockout for that user
a valid user from the same address is still let in
